messages:
Alex (CSM): Heads-up team  KiteWave EBR next Wed 10am PT. Need a sharp 10-slide deck + 1-page follow-up runbook by Mon EOD. Primary goal: demonstrate measurable adoption lifts and surface a clear 60-day retention plan for the sponsor.

Alex (CSM): Must-haves:
- Account health (cohort churn heatmap, API success rate)
- Onboarding progress + remaining blockers by owner
- Renewal posture + Ask (concession if needed)
- Two-track enablement: PM deep-dive + Ops playbook
- Feedback matrix with owners and target dates

Priya (CS Ops): I'll do the health slide. Planning to include cohort churn heatmap (30/60/90), API success rate, and a short note on last incident. Which cohort key should I use? integration_date or first_active?

Jordan (AE): Use first_active for cohort. Renewal posture: sponsor is cautious; propose a conditional extension (30 days of no-regression SLA) + exec check-in. I'll draft a single-slide ask and a suggested sentence for the exec: "Agree to a 30-day SLA extension contingent on 15% uplift in key module usage."

Alex (CSM): Sponsor is "Dana Reyes" (Head of Integrations). Jordan, include a 15-min sponsor agenda: 5m biz outcomes, 5m tech, 5m proposed commitment.

Sofia (Enablement): I'll produce two artifacts: 1) 20-min PM-led deep-dive recording (product value, config knobs), 2) a 12-step Ops playbook runbook (short YAML snippet in the slide). Office hours Tue 4pm PT. Draft links will be posted to /drive/kitewave/enablement.

Ravi (SE): For blockers I'm running a quick query for module-level adoption and a CSV of outstanding integration tasks. SQL below: 
```sql
SELECT module, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS users, SUM(case when completed then 1 else 0 end) AS completions
FROM onboarding_events
WHERE account = 'kitewave'
GROUP BY module
ORDER BY users DESC;
```
Will attach CSV + a small PNG with top-3 module adoption bars.

Priya (CS Ops): Unique ask: legal flagged APAC data residency as a concern in the last meeting. I'll add a short note and tag legal contacts. Also adding a small risk tile about region-specific compliance.

Alex (CSM): Action items (reply with DONE):
- Priya: Health slide with cohort 30/60/90 heatmap + API success rate + region risk tile (due Mon EOD)
- Ravi: Adoption CSV + top-3 module PNG (due Mon noon)
- Sofia: PM deep-dive recording + 12-step Ops playbook slide (due Mon EOD)
- Jordan: Renewal ask slide + sponsor agenda + suggested wording (due Mon EOD)
- Alex: 1-page post-EBR runbook and exec speaking bullets (due Mon EOD)

Jordan (AE): Quick note  can SEs include a perf-snapshot and a small example webhook payload to reassure the sponsor? Example payload would be helpful.

Ravi (SE): I'll include a sanitized webhook example and export perf-snap.png to /drive/kitewave/qbr/assets. Example payload below: 
```json
{"event":"integration_success","account":"kitewave","ts":"2026-03-10T14:00:00Z","module":"ingest","status":"ok"}
```
(Will anonymize IDs)

Sofia (Enablement): Ops playbook snippet (will be in deck as YAML):
```yaml
- step: verify_api_keys
  owner: ops
  check: call /health endpoint and confirm 200
- step: reconcile_billing
  owner: billing
  check: invoices matched within 48h
```
Will include link to full runbook.

Priya (CS Ops): Capturing feedback owners: billing visibility -> Jordan, API docs -> Ravi, APAC compliance questions -> Priya (we'll loop legal). I'll add to the feedback matrix slide with target dates.

calendar-bot: Reminder scheduled: final deck snapshot Mon 17:00 PT. Upload required or invite marked as "deck missing".

Alex (CSM): If we get the cohort heatmap + Ops playbook in the deck, we should materially lower the renewal friction. Ping me if anything blocks. :rocket
